question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

______ your time and decide which job you want.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**take your time**" means to not hurry and to consider something carefully. (अपने समय लें)
 
• It is appropriate to say **"Take your time and decide"** when advising someone to make a thoughtful decision.
 
• The other options: "**Have**," "**Make**," and "**Set**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Take__ your time and decide which job you want.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Have (रखना)**: means to possess or hold something.
 
• **Make (बनाना)**: means to create or construct.
 
• **Set (सेट करना)**: means to put or place in a particular position.
